EDA: Player Similarity Features¶

Identifying discriminative features from SkillCorner (tracking) and StatsBomb (events) for player similarity.

Section 1: Data Overview¶

SkillCorner: 10Hz positions (meters). StatsBomb: Event actions (120x80 grid).

============================================================
DATA OVERVIEW
============================================================

SkillCorner: 10 matches, 237 unique players, ~900 minutes
StatsBomb: 3464 matches, ~89960 unique players (estimated), ~311,760 minutes
Dataset Matches Players (est.) Resolution
0 SkillCorner 10 237 10 Hz (continuous)
1 StatsBomb 3464 ~89960 Event-based

SkillCorner: 10 matches, 237 players. StatsBomb: 3,464 matches. Combined for multi-modal representation.
